_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve heat#3: non-homogeneous Dirichlet needs the two-step pattern -- gfu.Set(bc, definedon=...) then gfu.vec.data += a.mat.Inverse(fes.FreeDofs()) * (f.vec - a.mat*gfu.vec). Measured on 6.2.2604 with the harmonic u = x^2 - y^2 on unit_square maxh=0.3, H1(order=2), which the space represents exactly: the two-step pattern gives an L2 error at machine zero, while the one-step assignment gfu.vec.data = Inverse*f.vec silently discards the Set boundary values and gives an O(1) error with no exception. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 gives the 'one_step' pass the two-step residual update gfu.vec.data += Inverse*(f.vec - a.mat*gfu.vec) instead of the plain assignment gfu.vec.data = Inverse*f.vec, i.e. the documented fix applied at the pathology site. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 6 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 drops the one-step L2 error from 4.7e-01 to 1.756e-16 and keeps its boundary values (final_max 1.0), so it removes 'one_step_error_order_one=True', 'one_step_boundary_values_lost=True' and 'error_ratio_over_1e10=True' and makes the forbidden 'FAIL:' appear. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
